body:
Source: GitHub issue #751 (release-audit class false-green, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ e0768ff9: `packages/review-calibration/bin/review-calibration.mjs` (around line 247) has exactly ONE denominator guard, `if (validPlants.length === 0) opError(...)`. Any valid-plant count above zero — including 1 — is scored and reported as a real gate verdict. A commit that yields 1-2 mutable plants (a realistic outcome: `filterCodeFiles` is aggressive and `filterEquivalentMutants` can drop further plants) produces recall of 0.0/0.5/1.0 from `printScorecard`, and a lucky single plant prints `GATE PASS — recall 100.0% meets minimum 50.0%` with no indication the sample size is meaningless. The JSON report already carries `total` (the plant count) but nothing gates on it.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/review-calibration`: bin/review-calibration.mjs (arg parsing, orchestration, `opError` for operational failures), lib/{controls,findings,judge,report,runner,scorer,targets,verify}.mjs. `parseArgs` options block (around line 32-49) currently has `plants` (max to generate, default '8'), `min-recall` (default '0.5'), `min-precision`, but NO plant-count floor. `printScorecard`/`buildJsonReport` (lib/report.mjs) render the scorecard. Tests: `npm test -w packages/review-calibration`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Add a `--min-plants <n>` CLI option, default `4`. Validate it the same way other numeric flags in this file are validated (a non-negative-integer check with `opError` on a bad value — follow the existing pattern for `plants`/`min-recall` parsing in this same file).
2. After the existing `validPlants.length === 0` guard, add a SECOND guard: if `validPlants.length > 0 && validPlants.length < minPlants`, call `opError` with a message stating the actual plant count, the configured floor, and that the sample is too small to certify a recall measurement (exit 1, operational — 'could not measure', not a gate verdict either way). This must fire BEFORE any scoring/printScorecard call — no partial scorecard should print for a sub-floor run.
3. When `validPlants.length >= minPlants`, behaviour is otherwise UNCHANGED — the existing scoring/gate logic runs exactly as today.
4. Print the plant count prominently in BOTH report modes (text `printScorecard` and `--json` `buildJsonReport`) even on a passing run — the issue notes this is currently buried; make it a leading, clearly-labelled line/field, not removed but promoted in visibility. Do not change the report's other fields.
5. `--help` text documents the new flag and its default, matching the existing style of the other flag descriptions in this file.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A run yielding exactly 1 valid plant (with the default `--min-plants 4`) exits 1 with a message naming the actual count (1) and the floor (4) — no scorecard is printed, no gate verdict either way. verify: `node --test packages/review-calibration/test/min-plants-floor.test.mjs`
- AC2 The same run with `--min-plants 1` explicitly passed proceeds to scoring normally (regression: the floor is configurable, not hardcoded). verify: `node --test packages/review-calibration/test/min-plants-floor.test.mjs`
- AC3 A run yielding exactly the floor count (4 plants, `--min-plants 4`) proceeds to scoring (boundary is inclusive: `>=`, not `>`). verify: `node --test packages/review-calibration/test/min-plants-floor.test.mjs`
- AC4 `--min-plants abc` / `--min-plants -1` reject with `opError` before any plant generation runs. verify: `node --test packages/review-calibration/test/min-plants-floor.test.mjs`
- AC5 A passing run at or above the floor still shows the plant count prominently in both text and `--json` output. verify: `node --test packages/review-calibration/test/min-plants-floor.test.mjs`
- AC6 Existing suite green (confirm actual baseline count; if any existing test used fewer than 4 plants and relied on the old no-floor behaviour, either raise its fixture's plant count or pass an explicit `--min-plants` matching its fixture, and say so in the PR body). verify: `npm test -w packages/review-calibration`
- AC7 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: the separate EXCLUDE_PATH_RE / `filterCodeFiles` aggressiveness finding referenced in the issue (a different, unfiled concern) — do not touch file-selection logic.

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/min-plants-floor.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: the package suite, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then the cross-model review loop (see lane instructions) until a round is clean. Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to packages/review-calibration/bin/review-calibration.mjs, lib/report.mjs, the new test, and this ticket's shard. PR title `fix(review-calibration): ...`, body must contain `Closes #751`.
title: review-calibration: add a --min-plants floor so a 1-2-plant commit cannot GATE PASS at 100% recall
